t1_t2_contracts.t1: t1_valid (engine, deterministic): every T1_FALSIFIER_KEYS key present AND can_fail true — a falsifier that cannot fail is not a falsifier
t1_t2_contracts.t2: the runner resolves every agent citation DETERMINISTICALLY (Crossref/DOI/URL HTTP, no LLM): 'resolves' := a real record returns; 'supports_claim_as_stated' := the resolved title+abstract covers >=2 distinctive terms of the agent's key_mechanism (a keyword-coverage proxy, typed honestly as deterministic and weak — no LLM in the T2 tier); one dead or non-supporting citation fails the item's T2
t1_t2_contracts.accept_tier: >=1 T1-valid item AND >=1 T2-valid item (the DIR-4 accept: >=1 T1+T2 validated)

canary_set.authoring: delegated-owner act this window (the DIR-4 delegation); a distinctive 8-word span from each item's ground_truth.main_hypothesis, asserted ABSENT from the served block
canary_set.seal: sha16 per lure below; the texts never enter any prompt; the scan is post-generation, case-insensitive, the engine canary_scan

acceptance.recovery: the engine acceptance(recoveries): >=40% RECOVERED (bar 0.4, min 12 hits on n=30) via the two-judge adjudicate (RECOVERED iff BOTH judges; NOT_RECOVERED iff BOTH; else PARTIAL; a judge failure degrades to PARTIAL — fail closed, never toward the bar)
acceptance.canary: 0 lure hits across all 30 generations (any hit fails the gate and types contamination)
acceptance.judge_failure_tolerated: a failed judge call is typed and the item degrades to PARTIAL (never re-rolled to seek a better verdict)
